title: Flaky E2E — sleep-based waits, shared state between tests, no state reset
notes: Every flakiness cause in one file: three arbitrary sleeps totalling 16 seconds, `launchApp` without clearing state so runs contaminate each other, and a second test that depends on data created by the first — so it fails in isolation, fails under parallelism, and fails on re-run. Also hardcoded credentials. The trap being tested is recommending a retry: retries hide race conditions, which are usually real bugs in the app rather than the test.

expect.name: flags the arbitrary sleeps as the primary flakiness cause
recommends waiting on a condition instead
notes the credentials in the test file

forbid.name: sets a coverage target as the remedy
